name: v2 Keycloak credential stuffing
description: Five or more Keycloak LOGIN_ERROR events across three or more distinct usernames from one client address within 10 minutes. ES|QL because keycloak.events is unparsed: type, ipAddress and username live only inside the message's key="value" pairs, so the rule extracts them at query time. Events carry host.name=soc-playground (the IdP is a service, not a role host); source.ip on the alert names the client.
query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE message LIKE "type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "ipAddress=\"%{IP:kc_ip}\""
| GROK message "username=\"%{DATA:kc_user}\""
| STATS failures = COUNT(*), accounts = COUNT_DISTINCT(kc_user), usernames = VALUES(kc_user) BY source.ip = kc_ip
| WHERE failures >= 5 AND accounts >= 3
